How-to guides are practical, goal-oriented recipes.  Unlike tutorials
(which teach concepts in a fixed order), each how-to guide solves a
specific problem and can be read independently.

**Prerequisites:** Familiarity with the core concepts from the
[Tutorials](tutorials.qmd) is recommended but not strictly required.

## How-To Notebooks

::: {#howto-listing}
:::


## Topics at a Glance

The guides are grouped into the same four topics used throughout the
documentation:

### Timelines, Events & Maps

- [How to Do Coordinate Math](howto/how01_coordinate_math.ipynb) ---
  Domains, TimeUnits, NumberType, and Coordinate arithmetic.
- [How to Use Advanced Conversion Maps](howto/how01_advanced_cmaps.ipynb) ---
  ChainMap, PiecewiseMap, TableMap, and vectorised operations.
- [How to Query Timestamps](howto/how01_advanced_timestamps.ipynb) ---
  TimeStamp, TimeIntervalStamp, boundary tables, and PyArrow.
- [How to Construct Timelines Manually](howto/how01_manual_timeline_construction.ipynb) ---
  Events via dict, parent/child hierarchies, and serialisation.
- [How to Load Data](howto/how01_loading_data.ipynb) ---
  Format-agnostic data ingestion with Loaders and EventStores.
- [How to Load Tabular Data](howto/how01_tabular_loaders.ipynb) ---
  CoordinateField, ComputedField, and custom loader configuration.
- [How to Work with Graphical Timelines](howto/how01_graphical_timelines.ipynb) ---
  TimeAxisPath, paths of several pieces, image-based timelines, and
  pixel-to-time conversion.
- [How to Transfer Annotations Between Graphical Analyses](howto/how01_thoresen_annotation_transfer.ipynb) ---
  SegmentLine, ConstantMap, MatchClaims with Projections, y-coordinate transfer.
- [How to Represent Areas of Page Images as Boxes](howto/how01_graphical_boxes.ipynb) ---
  BoundingBox, Quadrilateral and Box events, the time path of a page made
  from its boxes, pages built of accolades, DmosLoader, MeiFacsimileLoader,
  an IIIF volume along given paths, and Boxes in a package.
- [How to Build Beat Grids](howto/how01_beat_grids.ipynb) ---
  BeatGrid, tempo segments, beat tables, measure/beat queries, and
  annotation-tool export.
- [How to Encode and Play Flow Control](howto/how01_flow_control.ipynb) ---
  Jumps, jump targets, breaks, section breaks and barlines; playing flow
  control and its findings; repairing it; atomic sections, FlowMaps and
  virtual timelines.

### TimelineGroups

- [How to Align a Piano Roll (SUPRA)](howto/how02_supra_piano_roll.ipynb) ---
  End-to-end alignment: IIIF images, ATON, MIDI, Audio, and Score.
- [How to Save and Load Timelines, Groups and Bundles](howto/how02_group_and_bundle_files.ipynb) ---
  TimeToShare manifests with `to_dict` and `from_dict`: complete and minimal
  form, selecting one timeline or group, unknown keys kept, and a timeline of
  unknown length.

### AlignmentBundles

- [How to Create a Note Alignment](howto/how03_create_note_alignment.ipynb) ---
  MatchClaims, AlignmentBundle, MatchLines, and cross-group MatchStamps.
- [How to Align Multimodal Data (Beethoven)](howto/how03_beethoven_multimodal.ipynb) ---
  AlignmentBundle, flow control and the played-through score, OMR, 16+
  timelines across 3 domains.
- [How to Load the Vienna 4x22 Corpus](howto/how03_loading_vienna_corpus.ipynb) ---
  MatchfileLoader, 22 performances, AlignmentBundle.
- [How to Load an Audio-to-Score Alignment Corpus and Compare Performances](howto/how03_performance_precision.ipynb) ---
  PerformancePrecisionLoader, MetricMap from a Verovio timemap,
  granularity-tagged MatchClaims, cross-performer tempo comparison.
- [How to Load a parangonada Note Alignment Across Several Performances](howto/how03_parangonada.ipynb) ---
  ParangonadaLoader, one multimodal AlignmentBundle across five performances,
  divs/quarters and samples/seconds C-Maps, synchronous and NOMATCH MatchClaims.
- [How to Load an MPM-Toolbox Project (Score, Modelled Performance, Observed Alignment)](howto/how03_mpm_toolbox.ipynb) ---
  MpmLoader, the score in ticks and quarters with MPM markup carried as events,
  a modelled quarters/seconds TableMap, and the observed alignment as MatchClaims.
- [How to Load an Audio-to-Audio Alignment (Listen Here!)](howto/how03_listen_here.ipynb) ---
  ListenHereLoader, a dense audio-to-audio alignment matrix, the columnar
  MatchClaimField holding the complete pairwise topology, and a single point
  placed across every recording at once.
- [How to Load Musical Themes Aligned to Recordings (MTD)](howto/how03_mtd_themes.ipynb) ---
  MtdLoader, the Musical Theme Dataset read in place: a CD track with an
  excerpt per theme, one timeline per file of a theme, four groups by
  encoding, and the alignment as MatchClaims from its notes to CHUNK on the
  excerpt.
- [How to Load an IEEE 1599 Document](howto/how03_ieee1599.ipynb) ---
  IEEE 1599 spine/VTU hub relating score, page images, and audio as one
  multimodal AlignmentBundle.
- [How to Align an Engraved Score with a Recording and a Drawn Time Axis](howto/how03_engraved_score_alignment.ipynb) ---
  VerovioLoader, MapsLoader and ScoreWarpLoader: a score in exact quarters
  with notes by `xml:id`, a MAPS alignment as MatchClaims, a ScoreWarp time
  axis in `css_pixels`, `create_calibrated_child`, and the bundle saved as a
  package and read back.
- [How to Describe What a Bundle and Its Timelines Stand For](howto/how03_describe_the_work.ipynb) ---
  Statements and provenance on the bundle, a timeline and a region:
  `add_statement`, `add_verb` and rectangles, candidates and beliefs
  (`add_candidate`, `add_belief`, the belief filter), the manifest's inline
  `@context`, a timeline written alone, and
  the MEI header and MeLODy imports (`MeiHeadLoader`, `MelodyLoader`).
- [How to Keep MatchClaims, Projections and Beliefs in a Package](howto/how03_match_claims_package.ipynb) ---
  MatchClaims between events, a Projection for a side without one
  (`create_match_claims`, `Timeline.add_projections`), beliefs (`actor=`,
  `add_match_claim_belief`) and the belief filter, the MatchClaim and Projections tables beside the manifest and its
  `resources` through `to_file` and `from_file`, and why claims are added but
  never removed.
- [How to Write Event Files and Share Tables in a Package](howto/how03_event_files_and_packages.ipynb) ---
  A bundle's events written into event files beside its manifest
  (`to_file(events=True)`), a package of two bundles sharing its tables
  (`Package`, `write_bundle`, `to_file`), one manifest opened from
  `package.yaml`, the package check (`timetoshare.tables.package_problems`),
  IDs held once in a package, and one bundle written into the package again.

### In-depth Topics

- [How to Encode Song Genesis (Hendrix)](howto/how04_hendrix_song_genesis.ipynb) ---
  MatchClaim (synchronous vs conceptual), NOMATCH sentinels, TiliaJsonLoader.
- [How to Load CSV/TSV with column_specs and field_specs](howto/how04_loading_csv.ipynb) ---
  DataField blueprints, the Step-1 resolution chain, CompositeFieldParser,
  and a from-scratch `.solo` loader.
